rv.q: It begins the first chapter of Charles Dickens’ David Copperfield , the chapter itself entitled “I Am Born, as outstanding a chapter heading as there is on any library shelf. Given all that, I’m happy to report that Jeffrey Scharf, who wrangled book, music, and lyrics for Copperfield!
It's the 19th-century literature musical I didn't know I needed.
Gabriel Barre does a very spirited job of direction and choreography.
Despite its pacing problems, Copperfield! will likely delight Dickens fans and create some new ones, but it only partly fulfills its great expectations.
Scharf's tale tells it with heart, and it's well worth the search.

Copperfield! The New Musical has talent to spare, a handsome production, and a score filled with pleasant melodies. What it needs is a stronger editorial hand, fewer musical detours, and considerably more faith in its central character.

cn.t: Critics praise this ambitious Dickens adaptation for successfully tackling the complex novel's sprawling plot and memorable characters, with strong performances led by Bobby Conte in the title role.
